'''Darth Vilus''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] who died before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], producing over three thousands volumes of writings throughout his life. He had several apprentices, [[Darth Vilus's fourth apprentice|the fourth]] of whom he killed after catching him spying. After using the ritual of [[Force walk]], he began hearing voices of the bound [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] in his head and set out to find a cure. He discovered a [[Forbidden Ritual|forbidden ritual]] on [[Voss]] that could heal fractured minds and kept writings of this technique. Unfortunately, before Vilus could confirm this discovery, he went insane.

Years later, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who suffered a similar problem, discovered the writings of Darth Vilus in [[Darth Thanaton's private library]] and traveled to Voss, where they successfully performed a ritual, establishing control over the ghosts in their head.

==Behind the scenes==
While Darth Vilus never appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a 3d model of the character exist in the game files.<ref name="">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/darth-vilus|text=Darth Vilus &ndash; NPCs|work=[https://swtor.jedipedia.net Jedipedia.net]'s SWTOR Database|archivedate=20200503051653}}</ref>
